text: Not enough is being done to ensure safety at sporting events. To what extent do you agree with
this view? [30]
Wealthy celebrities have a duty to give time and money to charitable causes. To what extent do
you agree with this statement? [30]
To what extent can a nation’s written constitution safeguard people’s rights? [30]
To what extent should war always be the last option when countries attempt to resolve
conflicts? [30]
The problems caused by tourism are always greater than the benefits. Examine this
statement. [30]
Artificial intelligence should be welcomed not feared. To what extent do you agree with this
statement? [30]
Assess the importance of mathematics in education. [30]
Reading more books would have a positive impact on society. Discuss. [30]
Evaluate the view that the arts should not be about making money. [30]
To what extent has technology had a negative impact on the music industry? [30]
